[[Category:Transformer]]
The [[self-attention]] '''causal mask''' forbids position $j$ from attending to any position after $j$ in an [[autoregressive decoder-only Transformer]].

Standard scaled dot-product attention score

$$
\mathbf{S} = \frac{\mathbf{Q}\mathbf{K}^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}} \qquad\text{(raw scores, shape } T\times T\text{)}
$$

where $T$ is the token sequence length.

The causal mask is a matrix $\mathbf{M} \in \mathbb{R}^{T\times T}$ defined as

$$
\mathbf{M}_{ij} =
\begin{cases}
0, & j \le i \quad\text{(past and present are allowed)}\\[4pt]
-\infty, & j > i \quad\text{(future is forbidden)}
\end{cases}
$$

The masked attention is then

$$
\operatorname{Attn}_{\text{causal}}(\mathbf{Q},\mathbf{K},\mathbf{V})
= \operatorname{softmax}\!\bigl(\mathbf{S} + \mathbf{M}\bigr)\,\mathbf{V} .
$$

== Example ==

{{Hidden example}}
'''Setup'''

Let input token length $T=3$ and query-key vector dimension $d_k=2$, with

$$
\mathbf{Q}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
1 & 0\\
0 & 1\\
1 & 1
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
\mathbf{K}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
1 & 1\\
1 & 0\\
0 & 1
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
\mathbf{V}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
1 & 0\\
0 & 1\\
2 & 3
\end{pmatrix}.
$$

'''Standard score (S)'''

The raw scores are

$$
\mathbf{S}
=
\frac{\mathbf{Q}\mathbf{K}^\top}{\sqrt{2}}
\approx
\begin{pmatrix}
0.7071 & 0.7071 & 0\\
0.7071 & 0 & 0.7071\\
1.4142 & 0.7071 & 0.7071
\end{pmatrix}.
$$

'''Causal mask'''

The causal mask is

$$
\mathbf{M}_{ij}
=
\begin{cases}
0, & j \le i,\\[4pt]
-\infty, & j > i.
\end{cases}
$$

Thus

$$
\mathbf{M}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
0 & -\infty & -\infty\\
0 & 0 & -\infty\\
0 & 0 & 0
\end{pmatrix}.
$$

Adding the mask gives

$$
\mathbf{S}+\mathbf{M}
=
\begin{pmatrix}
0.7071 & -\infty & -\infty\\
0.7071 & 0 & -\infty\\
1.4142 & 0.7071 & 0.7071
\end{pmatrix}.
$$

'''Causal masked attention'''

Row-wise softmax gives the attention weights

$$
\mathbf{A}
=
\operatorname{softmax}(\mathbf{S}+\mathbf{M})
\approx
\begin{pmatrix}
1 & 0 & 0\\
0.6698 & 0.3302 & 0\\
0.5035 & 0.2483 & 0.2483
\end{pmatrix}.
$$

Finally, the causal attention output is

$$
\operatorname{Attn}_{\text{causal}}(\mathbf{Q},\mathbf{K},\mathbf{V})
=
\mathbf{A}\mathbf{V}
\approx
\begin{pmatrix}
1 & 0\\
0.6698 & 0.3302\\
1.0000 & 0.9930
\end{pmatrix}.
$$
{{End hidden}}
